author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Dave is rebasing his World Eaters army with SKULL bases (as seen in this short).

We produced thousands (10,000+) of high-quality 3D printable bases designed to save you time, unify your army, and make every model look incredible - plus physical options if you don’t have a printer.

We wanted to make these bases as easy and painless to use. That's why we've focused on making sure:

They print great in both resin and FDM
They are easy to support in your favorite slicer (resin) 
That no supports are needed for FDM printing 
That you get clean, reliable results across all base types 

Less time figuring things out. More time building your army.

Our campaign is now live on BackerKit: Mega Base Collection - 10,000+ STLs by MiniWarGaming
